title: Okinawa, Tohoku Named Must-Visits for 2027
paragraphs: If you're looking for travel inspiration for next year, Lonely Planet has released its list of the 50 best places to visit in 2027, with Japan being named twice.
Lonely Planet's Best in Travel list is based on places its writers and editors have visited and loved.
This year's list includes Okinawa, which was chosen by Lonely Planet's Asia editor, Selena Takigawa Hoy.
A three-hour flight from Tokyo brings you to Okinawa's main island to enjoy the unique local culture and a relaxing atmosphere — the perfect place for someone who needs a break from busy city life.

Also on this year's list is Japan's Tohoku region, which is in the north of the country's main island of Honshu. Tohoku was chosen by Irish writer Lisa Wynne, who has spent time traveling across Europe and Japan.
Wynne recommends walking Tohoku's Michinoku Coastal Trail, where she enjoyed both the natural beauty and the warm welcomes from local people.

One of Japan's best hiking routes, it covers over 1,000 kilometers and goes through Aomori, Iwate, Miyagi and Fukushima prefectures, so walkers can experience a lot of different scenery as well as different local cultures.

Those who prefer to travel to cities might want to visit some of the other Asian places on this year's list. Taiwan was on the list for the great food it offers visitors at its night markets — think fresh seafood and mangoes!
Or, they might want to visit Chengdu, the capital of China's Sichuan region. While it's a big city, with its many parks and teahouses, Chengdu is known for being quite relaxed.
And for animal lovers, the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding is at the center of work to protect the species, and tourists can visit and see some pandas up close.
